entities.name: Tura Kennerüd
entities.description: Human knight of Dominaria, scion of Argivian skyknights, who was among the first to join the New Coalition.

entities.name: Arna Kennerüd
entities.description: Ancestor whose aesthir was the forebear of Tura's mount.

entities.name: New Coalition
entities.description: Group Tura was among the first to join.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Where Tura's family line began during the Ice Age.

events.summary: Tura came of age and was given her own aesthir, a descendant of Arna Kennerüd's mount.
events.quote: When she came of age, Tura was given her own aesthir to ride and train

events.summary: Tura was among the first to join the New Coalition.
events.quote: Tura was among the first to join the New Coalition

relations.note: Tura's aesthir descends from the animal Arna rode; her lineage stretches back to Kjeldor.
relations.quote: a direct descendant of the animal Arna Kennerüd once rode into battle
